description: Spike contracts for one agent-run training-trace package. Stdlib predicates only: event_count >= 1, required kinds present, digests well-formed. No model, socket, or clock inside checks.

contracts.title: Trace contains at least one event
contracts.pass_condition: event_count is an integer at or above config.min_count and matches the events array length

contracts.title: Required event kinds are present
contracts.input_contract: the events array of the submitted run-artifact
contracts.pass_condition: each kind in config.kinds appears at least once; decision is allowed but not required

contracts.title: Event digests are well-formed and bound
contracts.input_contract: events_sha256 and the digest-only events projection
contracts.pass_condition: events_sha256 is the canonical digest of events; each args_sha256/result_sha256 is 64-hex or null
